notes.title: Announcing Patch 1.41 Update for Fuga: Melodies of Steel 2
notes.notes:
■Patch Notes (Version 1.41)
・DLC "Tail Concerto Sound Pack" support
・Added the Jukebox. You can choose your favorite BGM in intermission
・Added the songs sung by official support ambassadors to the Jukebox
・Added Favorites that allows you to set party members and call them up on the formation screen
・Added fast travel within the tank in intermission
・Minor bug fixes and improvements for game stability

We hope this improves your Fuga: Melodies of Steel 2 gameplay experience

notes.title: Patch 1.11: Bombs Are Easier to Use
notes.notes:
This is the director Niizato!
The Bombs introduced in Fuga: Melodies of Steel 2 are now easier to use with Patch 1.11.
First, plant a bomb on an enemy, and then attack their weakness to make the countdown go faster!
Now you can battle more effectively!

[previewyoutube=P03r_EwM31c;full][/previewyoutube]
